prompt: Student.java is provided and complete. Finish GradeBook.java, which stores students in a HashMap<String, Student> keyed by name and implements add, lookup, averageGrade, and honorRoll(threshold) returning an alphabetically sorted List of names.
explanation: A HashMap gives constant-time lookup by name, and put() with an existing key replaces the old value -- exactly what re-adding a student should do. averageGrade and honorRoll iterate over values(), showing how map contents feed ordinary loops. Because a HashMap keeps no reliable order, honorRoll must sort the collected names itself before returning them.
hints: Field: private HashMap<String, Student> students = new HashMap<>(); then add() calls students.put(student.getName(), student) and lookup() is students.get(name).
averageGrade: return 0.0 for an empty map first, then sum getGrade() over students.values() and divide by students.size().
honorRoll: add qualifying names to an ArrayList<String>, then Collections.sort(names) before returning.
